interpretation: STRUCTURAL: cosmological vorticity (B1) and ICRF frame spin produce the identical vector field; with both present the Fisher matrix has an exact 3-dimensional null space (ker J_eff not contained in ker D phi_vorticity). Vorticity is NOT identifiable without an independent frame-spin anchor, as the contract and ledger CL-011 state.

Without the spin nuisance the 16 low-order modes are well conditioned on this sky (cond ~7.7), so a glide/shear estimate is structurally possible; the largest leakages are toroidal-quadrupole vs glide (0.42) and rotation vs spheroidal-quadrupole (0.27) from non-uniform sky coverage.

The formal uncertainties (0.3-0.7 uas/yr) are statistical only, assume independent sources and ignore scan-law/magnitude-dependent systematics, ICRF-realisation errors and modes above l=2; they are NOT a forecast of achievable precision.

claims.claim: B1 cosmological vorticity is structurally degenerate with ICRF frame spin on any sky.
claims.limit: identity of the vector field w x n; exact null space of dimension 3 found numerically
